title: Toddlers' Responses to Strangers
official: The Malleability of Social Group Understanding in Infancy and Early Childhood
summary: The study will assess if toddlers show differences in stranger wariness according to race, temperament, social network diversity, and neighborhood diversity.

interventions.name: Children's stranger wariness response to strangers

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* typically developing
* age 13-24 months

Exclusion Criteria:

\- any known developmental delays
